children: Overview
U.S. community bank's Q3 EPS rose yr/yr to $0.72, net income up
Net interest margin improved to 4.33% from 4.18% a year ago
Noninterest income fell 29% due to no gains on SBA loan sales
Outlook
Company expects lower interest expense after redeeming subordinated debentures
Oak Ridge says reducing nonperforming assets remains its highest priority in coming quarter
Result Drivers
NET INTEREST INCOME - Q3 net income rose due to higher net interest income as net interest margin improved to 4.33% from 4.18%
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Q3 net income benefited from a $765,000 lower provision for credit losses
NONINTEREST INCOME DROP - Q3 noninterest income declined due to no gains on sale of SBA loans compared to $380,000 a year ago
